					<h2 class="elementor-heading-title elementor-size-default">3 accommodation options for your stay in Tarifa</h2>				</div>
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-d784041 elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="d784041" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
									<p>Simplify your trip planning. Matos Tarifa school offers three strategic options to combine with your kitesurfing course:</p><ul><li><strong>Vacation Apartments:</strong> Comfort, autonomy, and walking distance to the historic center.</li><li><strong>Guest House:</strong> Community vibes and optimized budget for solo travelers or groups.</li><li><strong>Campervan:</strong> Total freedom to sleep right at Los Lances or Valdevaqueros spots.</li></ul><p>Handpicked accommodations selected for their convenience, located less than 10 minutes from the kite spots.</p>								</div>

					<h3 class="elementor-heading-title elementor-size-default">Ático Apartment in Tarifa Center </h3>				</div>
		<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-a23d3fb e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child" data-id="a23d3fb" data-element_type="container" data-e-type="container">

									<p><strong>The Ático is the go-to apartment for our kitesurf school students</strong> looking for the perfect balance between local life and kite sessions.</p><p>Located in a quiet, private residence in the heart of Tarifa, this accommodation puts you at the center of the action while guaranteeing optimal rest after your lessons.</p><p><strong>Los Lances South Beach: only a 2-minute walk away</strong></p><p><strong>Old Town (Casco Antiguo):</strong> a 2-minute walk from Puerta de Jerez.</p><p><strong>Amenities:</strong> Supermarkets, kite shops, and restaurants within 500 meters.</p><p><strong>Sleeping Space:</strong> 1 bedroom with double bed + 1 sofa bed in the living room.</p>								</div>

					<h3 class="elementor-heading-title elementor-size-default">The Wild House – Guest House</h3>				</div>
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-ca0483d elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="ca0483d" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
									<p>The <strong>Wild House</strong> is a guest house specifically designed for kitesurfers, ideally located between the spots of <strong>Los Lances and Valdevaqueros</strong>, less than <strong>10 minutes by car from the center of Tarifa</strong>.</p><p>It features a <strong>shared kitchen and living room</strong>, <strong>free private parking</strong>, and <strong>Wi-Fi connection</strong>. Nestled in the heart of the natural park, it also offers a <strong>large garden</strong> with a <strong>barbecue</strong> to fully enjoy Tarifa&#8217;s unique atmosphere.</p><p>Perfect for kitesurfers wishing to share their passion, the <strong>Wild House</strong> can also be <strong>booked exclusively</strong>, ideal for a <strong>private event</strong> or a <strong>corporate team building</strong>.</p>								</div>
